Find the right water-cost input

Use charges that change when consumption changes.

01Assess02Plan03Document
01

Separate fixed and variable charges

Identify the water consumption charge and any wastewater charge based on consumption. Fixed account or service charges generally remain even when a fixture uses less water.

02

Check the units

The calculator expects CAD per cubic metre. One cubic metre equals 1,000 litres. Convert a bill’s units before entering a rate and check whether water and wastewater are already combined.

03

Watch tiered pricing

When prices change with consumption bands, the rate applicable to the water avoided may differ from the bill’s average. Use the current utility schedule for your building and record the date of your assumption.

Put it into practice

Use your own building data in the calculator and prepare a brief for your team.
